openings.stage: Priority Corridor (Taj East Gate to Mankameshwar Mandir)

source.title: Prime Minister inaugurates Priority Corridor of Agra Metro from Taj East Gate to Mankameshwar Mandir

lines.notes: Agra Metro Yellow Line (Line 1) priority corridor connects Mankameshwar Mandir to Taj East Gate (5.2 km, 6 stations: 3 underground, 3 elevated). Fully operational. Built and operated by UPMRC.
